purpose: Document local registry evidence and public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Official Puducherry sources document the Nilamagal land-record query and FMB/village-map services. The Nilamagal form requires region, taluk, revenue village and Patta or re-survey number. No survey identifier or point-to-village match was established, so no parcel-specific query or geometry request was made.
registryAssessment: The Puducherry Directorate of Survey, Settlement and Land Records issues settlement extracts, FMB copies and village maps, and runs Nilamagal land-record services across the Union Territory. These are official local survey and record services; they do not provide anonymous polygon coverage for this WUP locator.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Directorate functions include certified Settlement/FMB copies, village maps, boundary demarcation and new subdivisions.
Official description of Nilamagal query requirements (region, taluk, village, land type, Patta or R.S. number) and FMB extracts through CSCs.
Official land-record portal entry point; no record was searched because the exact revenue village/survey identifier is unknown.
Official district service page links to Nilamagal/GLR and identifies the Survey and Land Records department in Puducherry.
